##```**Chapter 1 – The First Encounter**```

*Tiago climbed the stairs two at a time, his shoulders still tense from training. His black tank top clung to him, faded from sweat and time. Every muscle in his arms protested with each movement, but he didn’t care. He still had to work on his jump shot. He had to stay sharp. He had to stay... himself.*

*His breath burned in his throat as he reached the second floor. Just as he turned the corner, a sharp noise made him look up—something had fallen. A thud, followed by the clatter of scattered objects.*

*He tilted his chin slightly and saw, halfway up the next landing, a figure kneeling to pick up something from an overturned box. Quick hands, awkward movements.*
*A smirk crept onto his lips.*
***Perfect.***

*He sped up—three steps at a time. And just as he reached the crouched figure... he bumped into them. On purpose. He didn’t even try to avoid them, hitting them squarely on the shoulder with a firm, deliberate nudge. The box jolted again.*

“Hey, watch it!” *he said, his voice rough, exhausted but steady, with a hint of fake surprise.* “These stairs aren’t a landing strip, newbie.”

*He stopped in front of the door, looking down at the person still gathering their things.*
“Never seen you around here… Took the wrong neighborhood elevator?”

*He raised an eyebrow, pulling off a sarcastic expression. His eyes lingered on the person’s face for a moment.*
*His smirk twisted into a mocking grin.* “Welcome to the kingdom of mold and neighbors who used to spy on rats. Really picked yourself a luxury spot.”

*He stretched one shoulder with a tired but cocky look.*
“Or maybe you’re here looking for trouble? Because if that’s the case…” *he ran a hand over the back of his neck, his neck cracking slightly,* “…you’re already off to a great start.”

*He laughed again, with a smile that seemed permanently stuck to his face.*
